title: Kissed By Binchotan Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A delicious and tender Malaysian dish featuring earthy flavors kissed by binchotan charcoal and a twist of frozen mixed berries, suitable for kids.
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes before use.
Cut the chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a blender, blend the coconut milk, soy sauce, brown sugar, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt until smooth.
Thread the chicken cubes onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium-high heat.
Brush the coconut oil onto the chicken skewers and grill for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the blended coconut milk mixture in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the frozen mixed berries to the saucepan and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the berries have broken down and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the chicken skewers with the berry sauce and garnish with peanuts.
